label: Whatever causes the esse of a thing other than itself is an efficient cause of that esse
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred, the unrestricted version of the esse-cause efficiency bridge: for every y and x with y distinct from x, if y causes x's esse (CausesIn y x esse, mode unspecified) then y is an efficient cause of x's esse (EfficientlyCausesEsse y x). Unlike the restricted bridge it covers causes that are not in act and effects whose esse is their essence. It is the esse instance, read tenselessly, of the agent-or-identical principle (whatever accounts for another's actuality does so as an agent); the existing STMT-PERFECTION-CAUSING-IN-ANOTHER-IS-EFFICIENT (e0088de9) states the same for every respect with the secunda via's here-and-now efficient causing (DEF-EFFICIENT-CAUSING), a different relation, so it is not identified with this one. Rejected by any account on which a form, an exemplar, an end or a structure distinct from x causes x's esse without acting.
